(CASE WHEN compare_customer_count = 0 THEN 0 ELSE compare_sales / compare_customer_count END)) * 100.0 / (CASE WHEN compare_customer_count = 0 THEN 0 ELSE compare_sales / compare_customer_count END) END AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS customerPriceGrowth, CAST( CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN compare_sale_quantity = 0 THEN 0 ELSE compare_sales / compare_sale_quantity END) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ((CASE WHEN current_sale_quantity = 0 THEN 0 ELSE current_sales / current_sale_quantity END) - (CASE WHEN compare_sale_quantity = 0 THEN 0 ELSE compare_sales / compare_sale_quantity END)) * 100.0 / (CASE WHEN compare_sale_quantity = 0 THEN 0 ELSE compare_sales / compare_sale_quantity END) END AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS unitPriceGrowth, CAST( CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN compare_customer_count = 0 THEN 0 ELSE compare_sale_quantity / compare_customer_count END) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ((CASE WHEN current_customer_count = 0 THEN 0 ELSE current_sale_quantity / current_customer_count END) -
